title: HttpContentCompressor / HttpResponseEncoder does not work with several HttpContent messages
body:
I'm using netty for for building a http reverse proxy.

Everything work well but when I try to I add a **HttpContentCompressor** to my "front" pipeline, I encounter a problem with big files.

For information, my pipeline is simply:

``` java
        pipeline.addLast("decoder", new HttpRequestDecoder( );
        pipeline.addLast("encoder", new HttpResponseEncoder());
        pipeline.addLast("compress", new HttpContentCompressor());
        pipeline.addLast("handler", new HttpProxyServerHandler(....));

```

When backend server send a small file (a file of 30k works), compression works well and browser  receives file correctly.
But when backend server send bigger file ( a file of 150k does not work), compression does not set Content-Length to the good zipped length and browser receives full file but wait for end of transfert...
##### Working example:

In response to a http request, from backend, proxy receives 2 objects:
**Object 1:**
DefaultHttpResponse, decodeResult: success)
HTTP/1.1 200 OK
Cache-Control: max-age=3600
Content-Length: 20923
Content-Type: application/javascript
ETag: "1365771653000-1710122363"
Last-Modified: Fri, 12 Apr 2013 13:00:53 GMT
Server: Play! Framework;1.2.5;prod

**Object 2:**
DefaultLastHttpContent(data: UnpooledHeapByteBuf(ridx: 0, widx: 20923, cap: 20923), getDecoderResult: success)

HttpObjectEncoder.encode() is called 3 times as parameter for _HttpObject msg _
_call 1:_
DefaultHttpResponse, decodeResult: success)
HTTP/1.1 200 OK
Cache-Control: max-age=3600
Content-Type: application/javascript
ETag: "1365771653000-1710122363"
Last-Modified: Fri, 12 Apr 2013 13:00:53 GMT
Server: Play! Framework;1.2.5;prod
Content-Encoding: **gzip**
Content-Length: **6071** -> zipped length

_call 2:_
DefaultHttpContent(data: UnpooledHeapByteBuf(ridx: 0, widx: 6061, cap: 8192), getDecoderResult: success)

_call 3:_
DefaultLastHttpContent(data: UnpooledHeapByteBuf(ridx: 0, widx: 10, cap: 256), getDecoderResult: success)
_note_: trailingHeaders is empty
